events.displayTitleCompact: Port Adelaide v West Coast Eagles
events.selectedSentence: Port Adelaide enter 14th and West Coast Eagles 13th; a late-season test of where both clubs finish.
events.fullSpiel: Port Adelaide are 14th with 8 points, while West Coast Eagles are 13th with 8. That makes this more than a date in Round 9: it is a late-season test of where both clubs finish, with the next chapter shaped by the separation they create or erase.
